raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Strength Programme for post-meniscal repair return to ski"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "strength & ski return"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Foundational strength & safe loading":
        warmup:
          walking 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progressive loading - emphasis on control":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks) cont:
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability and volume control":
        warmup:
          rowing 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat (assisted depth) 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          one_arm_bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          cause 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload week; technique focus":
        warmup:
          walking 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 2x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          thoracic_rotations 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength progression with controlled ranges":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 60 seconds
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Volume build with safety margins":
        warmup:
          rowing 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_raise 60 seconds
          thoracic_motilities 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength maintenance; start controlled ski simulation":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..7 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 2 deload":
        warmup:
          walking 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretches 5 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Return to higher-load with skiing-oriented intent":
        warmup:
          walk/jog 6 minutes (permitted light)
        main straight_sets:
          back_squat (box)
          4x4..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_crosc 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Ski prep: unilateral and knee-friendly":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_raise 60 seconds
          thoracic_mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Taper towards skiing strength peak":
        warmup:
          rowing 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Testing strength readiness":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x3..5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 3x3..5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full body stretching 5 minutes

ADDITIONAL NOTES:
- Avoid any jumping, deep knee flexion under load, or high-impact movements.
- Progression should be conservative; if pain or swelling increases, reduce load or revert to Phase 1 rep ranges.
- Emphasize controlled tempo, especially on knee-friendly squats and hinge patterns.
- Include skiing-specific drills off the bike or zero-impact activities as tolerated in warmups/cooldowns if desired.
